main.description: A region's ridden candidates, by id: those that enough distinct athletes have passed from start to end. A candidate stays ridden once it is, until its line or sport group changes. Never says how many athletes rode a candidate, who or when. Only the AppView's configured segment importer may call it, with service auth.

errors.name: NotImporter
errors.description: The caller isn't the configured segment importer, or none is configured.
